messages.content: How did coral stone houses keep cool?

**Cool vibes in coral‑stone homes**  

• The fort (and many historic houses) were built from coral rock and mortar, giving them solid, thick walls. *(Excerpt 3)*  
• Cooling came from the classic **wind‑tower** design, which caught breezes and pushed fresh air inside before electricity existed. *(Excerpt 1)*  

So, the natural airflow from wind towers, combined with the hefty coral‑stone walls, kept the interiors nicely chill.
